video_title: ‘The assumption is the Clippers are fearful’ – Spears on Kawhi investigation | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Silver's contradictory statements regarding the Clippers' investigation timeline
quotes.excerpt: Adam Silver's contradiction what he said at the beginning of the finals in early June.

text_blocks.speaker: Malika Andrews
text_blocks.text: It has been 10 months, Tim. What do you make of this?

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: Adam Silver's contradiction what he said at the beginning of the finals in early June. He was right then, and I will read the exact quote: 'We are close to the point now where I think we need to wrap this up because you also need finality. The team has to understand what situation they are going to be operating under, and so do the other 29 teams.' And by that he meant what are they operating under as they head into free agency and the trade market. So he knew this needed to be wrapped up weeks ago, and now it is weeks later. It does not make sense. You can tell me you are not in charge of the investigation, you are in charge of the league. It is time for a decision to be made for there to be some clarity.

quotes.speaker: Marc J. Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers' internal perspective on the ongoing NBA investigation
quotes.excerpt: I think the assumption is that the Clippers are fearful of what is to come.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: If the Clippers and Raptors have to go back and negotiate based on the ruling, that is fine. Let them get about that business.

text_blocks.speaker: Marc J. Spears
text_blocks.text: I think the assumption is that the Clippers are fearful of what is to come, but I am hearing that they want to get this done, that they feel like Steve Ballmer was a victim, that he is going to be innocent. We will see. But they are eager to get this done, and there is deeper than the Clippers. There are so many teams, players. You know how sad Brandon Ingram looked on the sideline with glow-rilla the other day? Looked like he was a man without a country.
